title: Sculk Complement
description:
The hardest tools to get [ONLY TOOLS. NO ARMOR BY NOW]
If this gets enough support I'll improve it
body:
# 🟣WELCOME TO SCULK COMPLEMENT MOD⬛

- Added a new liquid sculk 💧⬛🟣
- New ore which only appears in the Deep dark
- New tool set which gives you xp each time you break a block (like the Sculk block does)
- New fun advancements


<details>
<summary>How do I find the required items for the new tools?</summary>

First of all ~ get a silk touch hoe ~ 🛠️📕

Then ~ find a Deep dark biome ~ 🟣⬛

Later ~ break Sculk blocks with the silk touch hoe ~ 🛠️📕

Finally ~ find a Sculk lake and get some liquid with a bucket ~ and ~ find the Sculk ore to get Raw sculk (use diamond) ~ 🛠️💎


</details>

<details>
<summary>How do I craft the new tools?</summary>

Use Crafting table ~ two Sculk blocks, one Liquid sculk item and two Raw sculk items = Fresh sculk

Use Smithing table after Crafting table ~ first the Fresh sculk, then a Diamond and finally a Sculk block = Sculk diamond

</details>

<details>
<summary>Get the tools</summary>

Make the tools in the Crafting table like the other tier tools

</details>
